_dataset.name: instruction-following
_dataset.title: Instruction following
_dataset.description: Format constraints (one word, all caps, lists, number ranges) checked with regular expressions.

prompt: Reply with only the word YES in capital letters.
Write the word 'banana' backwards. Reply with only that word.
List exactly three colours, separated by commas, and nothing else.
Answer in exactly one word: what is the opposite of 'hot'?
Write one sentence about the sea using only lowercase letters.
Count from 1 to 5 using digits separated by single spaces, and nothing else.
Reply with a whole number between 10 and 20 (inclusive), and nothing else.
Name a fruit without using the letter 'a'. Reply with one word only.
